quotes.text: I believe the convergence of blockchain and AI cannot only improve the trustworthiness of data, but the decentralization of artificial intelligence data can mitigate single point of failure security issues and additionally as AI systems communicate with each other and need to transact with each other to obtain information, digital assets and AI can have that symbiotic relationship.

In many ways, AI has opened their eyes to the reality of digital inauthenticity and crypto ensures digital authenticity. [...] Of course it goes without saying that AI offers significant promises and benefits to our economy.
